verdicts.missing: The claim says the upgrade crosses a specific release, but the release is unnamed (*) and the quotes never describe an upgrade crossing any release. They only state kube-proxy/kube-apiserver/kubelet skew limits and an upgrade-ordering requirement.

The quotes set the permitted skew at up to three minor versions and say persistently three-behind proxies must be upgraded. They do not state that a proxy more than three minor versions older exists or is permitted; that state falls outside the stated limit.

The quote limits kube-proxy below 1.25 to at most two minor versions older than kube-apiserver. It does not say a proxy more than two minor versions older exists or is allowed; that state falls outside the stated limit.
